text_block_list.text:
On the way home after accompanying Tokai 
Teio on a shopping trip—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that the Prez in the bookstore?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what she's gonna buy~? Knowing 
the Prez, it's gotta be an amazing book!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Technical books on how to run fast, or 
knowledge on the mindset of an "Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna buy the same book 
too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Prez!!

No sooner had she said it than Tokai Teio 
dashed off toward Symboli Rudolf, who had 
just finished paying the bill.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wondered who it was, but it's just you, 
Teio. What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Pre-z! What kind of book did you 
buy? Tell me, tell me~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is this it? "Who is the Pun King?! 100 
Shockingly Hilarious Puns!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you hear me? "The Great King of 
Puns is—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A-Alright! H-Huh! Is that so~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you're interested, I can lend it to you 
later. I'm sure you will gain something 
from it as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: See you around, then.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ......A pun, huh~.
choice_data_list: Are you going to buy it?
Are you going to buy it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ......A pun, huh~.
choice_data_list: Are you going to buy it?
Are you going to buy it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll buy it! Teio-sama never goes back 
on her word!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Who knows, maybe the secret to strength 
is hidden inside those puns!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, it's gotta be!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna practice puns too! That way, 
I'll get even closer to the Prez!
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Guess what, Prez! I heard it's better to 
run along the rail in a race!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There are various conditions in any 
race. I don't think you can generalize 
what's best, though.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! It's a pun, a pun! You 'run' across 
the 'bridge'~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I see, I finally understand. However, 
if we are to connect 'bridges'—

Coming up with a pun that can make Symboli 
Rudolf laugh seems surprisingly difficult.

"Surely, this too will contribute to Tokai 
Teio's growth in some way."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's not like buying a pun book 
will turn me into the Pres, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head home, head home~♪

It was surprising that Symboli Rudolf went 
out of her way to buy a book to study 
puns, but that incident gradually faded 
from my memory.
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As a student of the prestigious Tracen 
Academy, to strive "triumphantly" in both 
running and academics—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Shall we "live" our days with no regrets?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Prez really is so cool! Even her 
greetings are totally on point~♪
choice_data_list: Was that supposed to be a pun just now...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No waaay~! There's no way such a grand 
greeting was just a pun~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Let us dedicate ourselves triumphantly to 
running and studies, and live each day 
without regrets!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How on earth is this a pun?!

The truth hit Tokai Teio with such a shock 
that she was left standing frozen in place 
for a while.
